pre_score_result_bytes.definition: UTF-8 byte length of the canonical one-row DB result whose SHA-256 equals the persisted live PostgreSQL result_sha256

measured_costs.interpretation: One synthetic TRAIN/DEV infrastructure observation. It establishes that costs are measurable on the real DB path; it is not a production-capacity estimate and must not be treated as an independent sample for WP-006 power.

power_note_for_wp006: M16 is the only potential relational falsification candidate. WP-006 must power any accepted M16 contrast on paired relational-subset-eligible base_scenario_id units/source families; the four smoke cases and repeated infrastructure runs do not increase benchmark N. M15 remains DEV-only unless separately versioned before HOLDOUT.
feasibility_stop_rule: Reject or keep M16 DEV-only if eligible count/source-family diversity, token/context, database build/runtime, or registry annotation cost prevents a lossless powered matched run. Never truncate relational results or relax subset eligibility after outcomes are known.
